full_text:
Shadow Kuolit is a Yama-Titan with the face of an Oni. This Titan in samurai armor possesses the unique ability to fight by using a sentient shadow.

History

Shadow Kuolit was invoked by one of the Casterwill Hunters on the island of Phoenix's volcano. It fought against Montehue's Fenris before clashing with Dante's Powerbonded Caliban. Shadow Kuolit was then defeated when Caliban used his own shadow, cast in the hot sun, to beat that of Shadow Kuolit. [The Dead Magic Island]

Abilities

Shadow Kuolit can control his shadow and use it like a weapon. Although he is unable to run or maneuver quickly due to his size, he is a master of swords and combat, able to fight on par against the powerful Caliban.

Gallery

Image caption: Shadow Kuolit's Amulet

Image caption: Shadow Kuolit's Icon

Image caption: Shadow Kuolit

Trivia

• Shadow Kuolit's summoning command is "Attack."
• Shadow Kuolit's name is based on the Wayang Kulit, Japanese shadow puppets. His appearance, however, is based on the Oni, much like Hitokiri.
• Shadow Kuolit was set to appear in "The Mystery of Shadowing", the unpublished 19th comic of the Huntik Magazine series. Concept pages showed him battling Powerbonded Vigilante in the snowy mountains of West Virginia.

International Names

French: Ombre Kuolit
